$comment: Every MindAttic scheduled job (MindAttic.Scheduler, formerly MindAttic.WatchDog). install.ps1 registers each one under \MindAttic\Scheduler\ (HOUSE-LAW-11), wrapped in conhost --headless and the mindattic-scheduler run wrapper (a GUI-subsystem program is started directly; a keepRunning daemon skips the run wrapper). "daily": "auto" jobs start at the slot Scheduler.Arrange puts in arrangement.json. See README.md for the fields.

jobs.name: Automata.Tick
jobs.description: Automata heartbeat: resumes parked runs and runs whatever is due. Runs only while you are logged on, because browser lanes cannot render in session 0.

jobs.name: Launcher.NightlyBackup
jobs.description: Launcher nightly backup, keeping the newest 30. Overnight, at the slot Scheduler.Arrange gives it (one job at a time). Runs while you are logged on; a missed slot runs as soon as the machine is next available.

jobs.name: IdiotProof.ResearchScan
jobs.description: IdiotProof research scan: one pass an hour, run in the IdiotProof Hub (`idiotproof research scan`), the one process that talks to Alpaca and the database. Needs the Hub service running.

jobs.name: IdiotProof.MomentumCollect
jobs.description: IdiotProof: imports Momentum.'s new videos and extracts their picks, through the Hub. Local (Central) times; in ET: 07:00, 08:00, 08:45, 19:15, 20:00, 20:45, 21:30, 22:30.
jobs.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "D:\Projects\MindAttic\IdiotProof\tools\scheduled-job.ps1" -Job IdiotProof.MomentumCollect -Run "momentum import; momentum extract"

jobs.name: IdiotProof.MomentumVerify
jobs.description: IdiotProof: checks Momentum.'s finished sessions against Alpaca bars and rewrites the claims report, through the Hub. 19:10 Central = 20:10 ET.
jobs.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "D:\Projects\MindAttic\IdiotProof\tools\scheduled-job.ps1" -Job IdiotProof.MomentumVerify -Run "momentum verify; momentum report"

jobs.name: IdiotProof.GapperRadar
jobs.description: IdiotProof: ranks the next session's possible gappers (gapper study signs plus Momentum.'s picks) into the 'Gapper radar' Alpaca paper watchlist and saves the list under D:\IdiotProofData\radar, through the Hub. In ET: 20:20, 21:45, 22:45, 08:55.

jobs.name: IdiotProof.MomentumArm
jobs.description: IdiotProof paper forward test (amendment 04): at 09:29 ET arms one 1-share Paper strategy per Momentum. pick (premarket-high break), through the Hub; never Live. It skips weekends and NYSE holidays and does nothing after the 15:30 ET entry window, so a late catch-up run is harmless.

jobs.name: IdiotProof.MomentumExpire
jobs.description: IdiotProof: after the close (16:05 ET) deactivates the day's flat Momentum pick paper strategies, so a day's premarket-high levels never carry into the next session, through the Hub.

jobs.name: IdiotProof.GapperRetire
jobs.description: IdiotProof: at 09:45 ET, after every gapper's 09:28 sell-by, soft-deletes (reversible) the day's flat Paper gapper strategies so none trades the next session on a stale signal; one still booking a position is retried next run (IP-T590). Log: scheduler-jobs.log.

jobs.name: IdiotProof.DataMirror
jobs.description: IdiotProof: mirrors D:\IdiotProofData (gapper-study bars, SEC company facts, FINRA, halts, radar, momentum; ~35 GB) to R:\Backup\IdiotProofData with robocopy /MIR, only what changed, build scratch folders skipped (IP-T581). Overnight, at the slot Scheduler.Arrange gives it; the overnight lock keeps it from overlapping the Launcher backup or any other arranged job. Log: scheduler-jobs.log.

jobs.name: JellyFinPoster.Refresh
jobs.description: Refreshes the Jellyfin Movies/TV Shows library artwork from trending TMDB titles, nightly at the slot Scheduler.Arrange gives it; a missed run catches up on the next wake or logon.

jobs.name: Orchestrator.Daemon
jobs.description: MindAttic Orchestrator daemon: started at logon and kept running (no time limit, restarted if it fails). Windowless; the dashboard finds it through its mutex.

jobs.name: UnstuckTaskbar
jobs.description: UnstuckTaskbar tray icon and global hotkey for /unstuck: started at logon and kept running (no time limit, restarted if it fails).

jobs.name: Lghub.LeakGuard
jobs.description: Restarts Logitech G HUB's lghub_agent once it leaks past 2 GB of private memory, hourly (lghub_system_tray relaunches it within seconds). Restarts are logged to %LOCALAPPDATA%\MindAttic\Scheduler\lghub-agent-restarts.log.

jobs.name: GridGame.Nightly
jobs.description: GridGame Gaiden nightly run (owner 2026-11-17: tests and telemetry overnight, never during the working day): the full test suite on a clean origin/main copy, bot balance soaks, a dev build and an endless telemetry run with its report, and a fix ticket per new failing test. Overnight, at the slot Scheduler.Arrange gives it. Logs and summary.md land in GridGame.Unity/artifacts/nightly/<date>.

jobs.name: Azure.BackupNightly
jobs.description: Azure SQL backup, nightly tier (MAT-T147, docs/ops/azure-migration/BACKUP.md): a full export (bacpac) of every always-on DTU database (IdiotProof, ClaudeActivity, MindAttic.Tickets, MindAttic.Orchestrator and any other Basic/Standard database on the server) to R:\Backup\MindAttic\azure, to blob db-backups/bacpac and, off Azure, to the mindattic.com hosting account over FTPS (/Backups/azure, MAT-T156), each checked offline. Retention on all three: 30 days rolling, never fewer than the newest 2 per database. An FTP failure does not fail the backup (exit code 2, reported in the log). Overnight, at the slot Scheduler.Arrange gives it. Logs: R:\Backup\MindAttic\azure\logs.

jobs.name: Sql.BackupLocalNightly
jobs.description: Local SQL Server backup, nightly (M.SCHD-T73; replaces the Azure backups since the databases moved back to this PC, MAT-T255): native BACKUP DATABASE WITH CHECKSUM (compressed where the edition allows), then RESTORE VERIFYONLY, of every online read-write database on LocalDB and the full local SQL Server, to R:\Backup\MindAttic\sql\<instance>\<db>. Keeps a trailing 7 days, never fewer than the newest per database. Frozen *_Local_<date> copies and scratch test databases are skipped. Overnight, at the slot Scheduler.Arrange gives it. Logs: R:\Backup\MindAttic\sql\logs.

jobs.name: Database.SyncToRemote
jobs.description: Syncs the local SQL Server databases to their remote copies (M.SCHD-T60; the Hetzner host once it exists): mindattic-scheduler dbsync. Change Tracking watermark captured at each run's START, so rows written during a run are caught by the next; unchanged databases are skipped; the first run (and a missing or empty target, whose schema is bootstrapped) copies everything. Never alters a schema. DISABLED until the remote host is up and dbsync.json names its targets (README, Database sync). Overnight, at the slot Scheduler.Arrange gives it. Log: %LOCALAPPDATA%\MindAttic\Scheduler\dbsync.log.

jobs.name: Prose.GLMZ.Wiki.Sync
jobs.description: Keeps the GLMZ wiki (mindattic.com/glmz) and the Prose database in step, by push (PRS-T1064; was every 5 minutes, PRS-T1049, and nightly before that, M.SCHD-T40). Started at logon and kept running: Prose tools/wiki/wiki-watch.ps1 -Daemon is woken within seconds by the Prose Hub's change stamp (written after every save that changes what the wiki shows) and looks at the wiki for people's edits every minute (one API call; the wiki's host cannot call this PC). Prose changed: once writing has been quiet 2 minutes (at most 30), it reconciles, then runs sync-wiki.ps1. The wiki changed: wikireconcile.py turns the edits into proposals on GLMZ Wiki:Reconciliation and holds those pages. A full sync and check still run once a day. Logs: watch.log, sync.log, out\reconcile.md in %LOCALAPPDATA%\MindAttic\Prose\wiki\glmz.

jobs.name: Azure.BackupWeekly
jobs.description: Azure SQL backup, weekly and large tiers (MAT-T147, docs/ops/azure-migration/BACKUP.md). Runs every night but exports a free-offer serverless database at most once every 7 days (the four over 2 GB - Prose, IdiotProof_History, IdiotProof_Research_GAP, IdiotProof_Research_T375 - every 28 days), and never one that is paused and unchanged since its last export, so paused databases are not woken and the 100,000 vCore-second monthly allowance is kept for real work. Same three destinations (disk, blob, FTP), offline check and retention as Azure.BackupNightly: 30 days rolling, never fewer than the newest 2 per database (MAT-T156). Overnight, at the slot Scheduler.Arrange gives it; most nights export little, but a night the large databases are due runs for hours. Logs: R:\Backup\MindAttic\azure\logs.

jobs.name: Azure.RestoreDrill
jobs.description: Azure SQL restore drill, monthly (MAT-T156, docs/ops/azure-migration/BACKUP.md): for every always-on database, downloads its newest export from the off-Azure FTP copy, checks its SHA-256, imports it into a scratch database on LocalDB (the full local SQL Server is not needed), checks the restored row total against the package and compares every table with the live database, then drops the scratch. The Scheduler has no monthly trigger, so it starts every Sunday at 06:30 and the script skips a database drilled less than 28 days ago. Serverless databases are not drilled here (a comparison would wake them); run Test-BackupRestore.ps1 by hand for those. Logs: R:\Backup\MindAttic\azure\logs\restore-drill-*.log.

jobs.name: Scheduler.Arrange
jobs.description: Arranges tonight's overnight jobs (M.SCHD-T42): mindattic-scheduler arrange keeps the "daily": "auto" slots in %LOCALAPPDATA%\MindAttic\Scheduler\arrangement.json, re-placing them from each job's measured run time (else its estimate) only when something is wrong - a new or removed job, two starts colliding, or a predicted finish after 08:00 - then reruns install.ps1 so Task Scheduler has the new times. Pinned at 23:30, before the window it arranges.
